Proposed (transformer w3, q0.9, persistence 1) at default replay yields ~0.01/h, OK. However threshold_q=0.9 is allowed; persistence=1 allowed; window=3 allowed. Main issue: intent says “as fast as possible after onset” but policy doesn’t justify staying within budget beyond replay; also persistence=1 may be too aggressive for unknowns—revise to explicitly enforce <=1.0/h (e.g., higher q or persistence) per capability tradeoff."}
